test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 9.6 : 16.8 :: 18 : x, what is the value of x?
solution:
**Given:**

9.6 : 16.8 :: 18 : x

**Formula used:**

The ratios can be written as:

(9.6 / 16.8) = (18 / x)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 9.6 / 16.8 = 18 / x

⇒ x = (18 × 16.8) / 9.6

⇒ x = 31.5

**∴ The value of x is 31.5.**
